izzyondroid:com.tiefensuche.soundcrowd.description:
SoundCrowd is a free, open-source and lightweight music player for Android in modern material design, specialized for playing long music tracks (DJ mixes, live sets, audio books).
 It features the generation of waveforms that visualize your music tracks during playback and can be used for precise seeking through gestures.
 You can create cue points at your favorite positions in your music tracks. With these markers in the waveform, you can remember them and easily jump back to them.
 Want to know the track id of a specific part in a mix? SoundCrowd comes with build-in audio tagging support by using SongRec, an open-source Shazam client implementation, and creates cue points for found track ids. Unlike Shazam, the app records the internal audio of the player, so you don't need to grant access to the microphone or play the music loud!
 The app contains build-in plugin modules to support the following online streaming services:
 SoundCloud
 YouTube
 Spotify
 Beatport
 Tidal

izzyondroid:tk.zwander.lockscreenwidgets.name: Widgets Anywhere
izzyondroid:tk.zwander.lockscreenwidgets.summary: Use your widgets on the lock screen again!
izzyondroid:tk.zwander.lockscreenwidgets.description:
A (very) long time ago, Android introduced a feature to allow you to show certain widgets on the lock screen. For some reason, this useful feature was removed with the release of Android 5.0 Lollipop, confining widgets to the home screen only.
 While some manufacturers, such as Samsung, have brought back limited versions of lock screen widgets, you’re usually limited to the widgets the manufacturer has already created for you.
 Well, no more! Lockscreen Widgets brings back the functionality of yore, with some extra features. Note that Lockscreen Widgets is not designed to function on the Always-On Display.
 Lockscreen Widgets appears as a paged "frame" on top of your lock screen.
 Add a widget by tapping the plus button in the frame. This plus button will always be the last page.
 Each widget you add gets its own page, or you can have multiple widgets per page.
 You can press, hold, and drag widgets to reorder them.
 You can press and hold widgets to remove them or edit their size.
 Tap the frame with two fingers to enter the editing mode where you can resize and move the frame.
 Tap the frame with three fingers to temporarily hide it. It will show up again once the display turns off and back on.
 Any home screen widget can be added as a lock screen widget.
 Lockscreen Widgets also includes an optional Widget Drawer!
 Widget Drawer has a handle you can swipe to bring it up from anywhere, or you can use the Tasker integration or shortcut to open it however you want. The drawer is a vertically scrolling list of widgets that can be resized and moved the same way as in the Lockscreen Widgets frame.
 And this is all without ADB or root! All the basic privileges can be granted without even thinking about using a computer. Unfortunately, with Android 13 and later, you may need to use ADB or Shizuku to enable Masked Mode.
 On the topic of privileges, these are the more sensitive permissions that Lockscreen Widgets needs to function:
 Accessibility . In order to display on the lock screen, Lockscreen Widgets’ Accessibility Service must be enabled. You will be prompted to enable it if needed in the initial setup, and any time you open the app.
 Notification Listener . This permission is only required if you want the widget frame to hide when notifications are displayed. You will be prompted if it’s needed.
 Dismiss Keyguard . In order to improve the user experience, Lockscreen Widgets will dismiss the lock screen (or show the security input view) when it detects an Activity being launched from a widget, or when you press the "Add Widget" button. This will not compromise your device’s security in any way.
 And that’s it. Don’t believe me? Lockscreen Widgets is open source! The link is at the bottom.
 Lockscreen Widgets only works on Android Lollipop 5.1 and later because the necessary system features for displaying on the lock screen didn’t exist in Lollipop 5.0. Sorry, 5.0 users.
 If you have a question, send me an email, or join the TG group: https://bit.ly/ZachareeTG. Please be as specific as possible with your problem or request.

fdroid:com.Obscrum.pchwmonitor.name: PC HW Monitor
fdroid:com.Obscrum.pchwmonitor.summary: Real-time Windows PC hardware stats (CPU, GPU, RAM) on your phone over Wi-Fi
fdroid:com.Obscrum.pchwmonitor.description:
PC HW Monitor shows your PC's real-time hardware statistics on your phone — over local Wi-Fi, or anywhere via an optional Cloudflare Tunnel.
 Features 
 CPU, GPU, iGPU and RAM cards with temperatures, usage, clock speeds, power, VRAM/RAM and per-core loads
 Disk, network, fan and FPS cards (FPS via embedded PresentMon)
 Live charts and 1-hour history (stored locally on the device)
 9 color palettes with light and dark variants, dashboard edit mode, landscape mode
 Multi-PC support: connect to several PCs and switch via dashboard tabs
 Optional TLS/SSL (wss://) and Cloudflare Tunnel for secure remote access
 QR quick connect, network scan, persistent notification with live stats
 14 languages, selectable in Settings
 How it works 
 Run the bundled single-file Windows server (no installation needed) on your PC. It reads hardware data from LibreHardwareMonitor and streams it over WebSocket to the app once per second. By default the app only talks to the server over your local Wi-Fi; no data leaves your network unless you enable the optional Cloudflare Tunnel.
 No PC hardware available? Start the server with --simulate to generate realistic fake data.
 License 
 AGPL-3.0. The Windows server bundles LibreHardwareMonitor (AGPL-3.0), cloudflared (Apache-2.0) and PresentMon (MIT).
 If this app is useful to you, consider supporting development on Patreon: Patreon .

 Sun, moon & direction

• The moon drawn in its current phase, with its illumination, and the Birkat HaLevana window with its text
• Jerusalem compass, measured from true north: direction and distance to Jerusalem from your city
 Zmanim (Prayer Times)

 Torah & Tehillim Reader

• Daily Chitas (חת"ת) — the Chabad study cycle's Chumash aliyah, Tehillim and Tanya for the day, in one reader, chosen with a three-part toggle (optional, off by default)

 Siddur at prayer times

 Display 
• Persistent lockscreen notification — always visible without unlocking
• Home screen date widget with adjustable background transparency, and a month-calendar widget with its own month navigator (tap a day to open it)
• Gregorian date shown alongside the Hebrew date
• Survives Do Not Disturb and Bedtime mode with optional DND bypass permission
• Save and restore all settings to a file
 Privacy

• Location used only once to match the nearest city; stored locally and never transmitted
• Calendar and zmanim work fully offline; the text reader fetches from the Sefaria API and cac

fdroid:org.openobservatory.ooniprobe.name: OONI Probe
fdroid:org.openobservatory.ooniprobe.description:
Are websites and social media apps blocked? Is your network unusually slow? Run OONI Probe to find out!
With this app, you will examine the blocking of websites and instant messaging apps, measure your network's speed and performance, and check whether systems that could be responsible for censorship and surveillance are in your network.
OONI Probe is developed by the Open Observatory of Network Interference (OONI), a free software project (under The Tor Project) that aims to uncover internet censorship around the world.
Since 2012, OONI’s global community has collected millions of network measurements from more than 200 countries, shedding light on multiple cases of network interference.
▶ Collect evidence of internet censorship
You can check whether and how websites and instant messaging apps are blocked. The network measurement data you will collect may serve as evidence of internet censorship.
▶ Detect systems responsible for censorship and surveillance
OONI Probe tests are also designed to uncover the presence of systems (middleboxes) that could be responsible for censorship and surveillance.
▶ Measure the speed and performance of your network
You can measure the speed and performance of your network by running OONI's implementation of the Network Diagnostic Test (NDT). You can also measure video streaming performance with the Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (DASH) test.
▶ Open data
OONI publishes network measurement data because open data allows third parties to verify OONI findings, conduct independent studies, and answer other research questions. Openly publishing OONI data also helps increase transparency of internet censorship around the world. You can explore and download OONI data here: https://ooni.io/data/
▶ Free software
All OONI Probe tests (including our NDT and DASH implementations), are based on free and open source software. You can find OONI software projects on GitHub: https://github.com/ooni. Curious to learn how OONI Probe tests work? Learn more: https://ooni.io/nettest/
To receive updates from the OONI-verse, follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/OpenObservatory

apple-macos:6754225657.description:
Mindomax turns your notes, PDFs, photos, and recordings into flashcards, then uses spaced repetition to bring each card back right before you'd have forgotten it. You study what your class actually covers, not somebody else's summary.
AI flashcards from your own material
• Drop in a PDF and go from PDF to flashcards in one step — or type or paste notes, snap a photo of a page, or record a few minutes of audio, and the AI Card Generator builds the deck for you.
• You pick the language and how many cards you want.
• Card answers support math formulas (LaTeX) and AI-generated images, so a chemistry structure or an anatomy diagram sits right on the card instead of plain text.
• Spaced repetition schedules every review, card by card, so the hard ones come back more often.
Notebooks
Point Mindomax at your files and get a single study guide back: a Topic Tree mind map, diagrams, and worked examples you can follow step by step.
A PDF reader with the AI Tutor on the page
Read a page, then ask the AI Tutor about it. It answers from what's actually on that page and tells you which page it came from. Highlight, draw on, and annotate the PDF, or reorder and delete pages — all of it works offline.
Start from a ready-made library
Millions of ready-made flashcards, already sorted by subject: languages, medicine, test prep, science, and business. Preview any deck and add it to your own decks.
Streaks, stars, and medals
Every study day fills in a square on your activity heatmap. Keep the streak going, earn stars, and collect medals. Stay away too long and Mindomax's reminders start taking it personally.
Themes you unlock
Spend the stars you earn on a whole new look for the app: Papercraft, Fantasy, or Anime.
Learning analytics
Your Performance Radar and Personal Learning Curve show when in the day you learn best and which topics you keep forgetting.
Study planner and focus
Plan tasks by day, week or month, with labels. Time your study with Pomodoro or a stopwatch, set weekly goals, and see where your time goes in Reports. Each week, look back and get tips from your AI coach. It all syncs across your devices.
Mindo Cloud
Your PDFs, recordings, and photos are there on every device you use. Study offline, and everything syncs as soon as you're back online.
Wherever you study
Study on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or the web, in 16 languages. Sign in with Google or Apple and pick up where you left off.
Mindomax is free: there's nothing to buy and no subscription.
Built for medical and nursing students revising pharmacology before a shift, law students working through case after case, language learners building vocabulary a few minutes at a time, and anyone with an exam coming up and a lot of facts to keep straight.
Add your first PDF and you can have a deck ready before your next class.

firefox-addons:2809409.name: Inbox Reborn theme for Gmail™
firefox-addons:2809409.summary: Google Inbox, back in Gmail: bundles for labels and categories, sweep, pins, reminders, speed dial, sender photos and dark mode. One Stock Inbox switch sets it up.
firefox-addons:2809409.description:
Inbox Reborn brings Google Inbox back to Gmail. Turn on Stock Inbox and your Gmail reads and works the way Inbox did; customize anything after.
BUNDLES, LIKE INBOX'S
- Travel, Purchases, Finance, Social, Updates, Forums and Promotions bundle on their own, in Inbox's colors and order, with Gmail's own sorting behind them.
- Bundle any label: the left menu is split into "Bundled in the inbox" and "Unbundled". Drag a label up and its mail collapses into a bundle; drag it down and it shows as rows again. Your mail moves with it.
- Each email sits in one bundle, and a travel label of yours (Cruise, Trips) counts as Travel.
- Fold either section of the menu up with the arrow beside its title.
THE INBOX, THE INBOX WAY
- Mail grouped by date: Today, Yesterday, This week, This month.
- Sweep: one click on a date heading marks the whole group done. Pinned mail stays. Gmail's Undo brings it back.
- Pins instead of stars, with a Pinned switch in the header that shows only what you pinned.
- Reminders: an email to yourself shows as a reminder, with Inbox's icon.
- Hover actions on every row: Pin, Snooze, Trash, Done, and the rest of Gmail's menu.
- Sender pictures on the avatars where there is one; a colored initial otherwise.
- Calendar invitations as a small card with inline responses.
SPEED DIAL
Hover the red Compose button for the people you write to most, and start an email to one of them in a click.
DARK MODE
A built-in dark theme in Inbox's own colors, for the inbox, conversations, compose and settings. It works with any Gmail theme.
STOCK INBOX
One switch, on for new installs, that sets everything to the way Inbox had it: bundles, avatars, the clean list and Inbox's left menu. Change one thing and the switch remembers your change.
PRIVACY
Everything runs in your browser. The extension asks Gmail, with your own session, which inbox mail is Travel, Purchases and Finance, and nothing leaves your machine unless you turn on Gravatar photos. Full policy: https://github.com/team-inbox/inbox-reborn/blob/master/PRIVACY.md 
MANUAL

CHANGELOG
 https://github.com/team-inbox/inbox-reborn/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md 
Inbox Reborn is open source: https://github.com/team-inbox/inbox-reborn

Dictate notes, record meetings, transcribe lectures, convert audio or video into text, and translate speech or written text in one focused app. Whether you are writing hands-free, reviewing an interview, preparing meeting minutes, or saving class notes, it keeps your voice, recordings, and transcripts easy to work with.
Voice Dictation

• Create notes, messages, journal entries, drafts, and longer documents
• Configure three independent language zones for multilingual work
• Supports more than 40 dictation languages
AI Transcription

• Use AI speech recognition for fast, high-quality transcripts
• Supports over 100 transcription languages
Translation

• Dictate in one language and work with the result in another
• Share translated text with other apps in just a few taps
Files, Export, and Sync

• Export dictations and transcripts as text files or PDFs
• Organize recordings, notes, and transcripts for later use

Designed for Everyday Productivity
• Record and replay dictations

• Use Apple Shortcuts to speed up repeated workflows
• Improve recognition with a custom user dictionary
• Undo text edits when you need to revise quickly

Accessibility and Comfort
• Compatible with VoiceOver
• Adjustable text sizes for better readability
• Customizable button layout for easier use
• Optional dictation privacy mode, depending on device capabilities
Voice to Text - Dictate Speech is built for students, writers, journalists, professionals, travelers, and anyone who wants to capture speech, audio, meetings, notes, and ideas without typing everything by hand.

apple-macos:6763797883.name: Ink: Notes, Lists & To-Dos
apple-macos:6763797883.description:
Ink turns your voice into finished notes and lists. No re-typing, no cleanup.
Tap the microphone, speak naturally, and watch your words land as a clean list, a note, or a tidy paragraph. Ink shapes the transcript while you watch, so you see the result before it's saved.
WHAT'S INCLUDED, WHAT'S PRO
Notes, to-dos, reminders, repeats, links, shelves, Markdown export, and iCloud sync are free, no account required.
Pro adds dictation with AI formatting, file import, your own templates, version history, a focus timer, ledger mode, the richer copy formats, shared lists, Today layouts you can arrange, font packs, accent colors, and paper tones.
Your 14 days of Pro don't begin when you install. They begin the first time you open something Pro, so the two weeks are two weeks you spend.
EARLIER VERSIONS OF EVERY PAGE
Ink keeps a version of a page as you leave it. Read last week's draft beside today's, lift a paragraph back out, or bring the whole thing back as a new page, which leaves everything you have written since where it is. Stored on your device, the newest 50 per page.
THE INDEX AT THE BACK OF THE NOTEBOOK
Every unfinished checkbox scattered through your notes, gathered on one page. Every passage you marked, on another. Check something off and it leaves the index on its own. Nothing to file, nothing to keep tidy.
TEMPLATES FOR THE THINGS YOU DO AGAIN
Turn a list you already keep into one you can run again. Ink clears last time's checkmarks and amounts, then asks for a name and a date, so "book transport seven days before" lands on the right day this time.
PULL THE WORDS OUT OF A FILE
Send a PDF, a document, or a photo of a page to Ink, or tap + and choose Import, and it reads the words into a note. Ink keeps the words, not the file. Scans and photos are read on your device, so nothing is sent anywhere.
ON YOUR WRIST
Ink on Apple Watch shows what's due and lets you check it off without reaching for your phone. Put the next thing on your watch face and it's there at a glance.
ASK SIRI, WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
Say "Add an item to Ink" or "Show my Ink today" and it happens. Every action works in Shortcuts and on the Action Button, and your notes turn up in Spotlight.
DATES YOU CAN JUST TYPE
Write "Dentist Friday 4pm" or "rent next week" and Ink reads the date and leaves the title clean. A chip shows what it heard, so you can wave it off and keep your exact words.
DESIGNED LIKE A BOOK, NOT AN APP
Ink draws from print: warm cream paper, ink-dark serif type, the editorial details of well-made books. Four Today layouts to open to, from a newsprint spread to a magazine front page.
WRITE IT THE WAY YOU MEAN IT
Bold, italic, strikethrough, underline. Section headers. Checklists inside a note, tap a line to check it off.
REMINDERS, ONLY IF YOU ASK
One quiet notification on the day something is due, at the time you choose. Off by default. Set an item to repeat daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly and it comes back on its own.
A TIMER FOR SITTING DOWN TO WORK
Set 15, 25, 45, or 60 minutes and Ink keeps a quiet countdown, then sounds a soft chime you choose.
SHARE A LIST, KEEP IT IN SYNC
Invite another Ink user by email. Check off, add, reorder, even dictate, and both copies stay in sync. A quiet byline shows who added each item.
LISTS THAT KEEP A LEDGER
Flip a list into Ledger mode and it keeps score. Type signed amounts (+$25, -$10, +200) and Ink totals each section, then the whole list.
BRING IT WITH YOU, OR TAKE IT SOMEWHERE ELSE
• Import PDFs, HTML, rich text, Markdown, plain text, and photos of a page
• Copy any note or list as Markdown, or as plain text, HTML, or rich text with Pro
• One-tap JSON backup and one-tap restore
• iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac
• Universal purchase, buy once, use everywhere
